text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to demonstrate the utility of Tracen Island,
each of them tried their hardest to promote it.
However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I understand the appeal, but...
how should I put it, after all—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: It's more like... the feeling of "Tracen Academy is more than enough for me" ends up winning out~.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?! I see.
Anyway, thanks for hearing me out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bringing back the Umamusume who had once left
was far more difficult than imagined...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...What should I do?
There's not much time left."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...! A-Argh, damn it...! We were just one step away...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
A facility meant to help them grow stronger...
all ruined because of my pathetic past.
How utterly shameful of me.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, how pathetic of me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Tucker-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(—Drag them along by force? No, no,
as if! But if things go on like this, the island will—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no no!
I'm starting to get down in the dumps!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll watch one of Maruzen-san's races
and reset my mood—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"‘Maruzensky is looking strong!
Maruzensky is so strong...!’"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Haa, haa, haa!
Fufu, ahaha...!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Fuuu!
Haaaaahhhhhh—!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, as expected of Maruzen-san...!
No matter how many times I see it, you're the greatest...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Haaah... It's so nice after all.
It kind of makes me want to run too.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Right now, I...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do is show them how I run!
If I show them how I run with pure instinct unleashed—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We're all Umamusume after all!
Everyone's bound to want to run on Tracen Island!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, first things first...
A proposal! I need to write a proposal and talk it over...!
